name: Folder Compare
description: Compare two folders, see changed text files side by side and copy differences across
help: Choose a left and a right folder and press Compare. Quick mode compares size and modification time; content mode also reads files of equal size, so it finds edits that kept the size and time.
Ignore takes comma-separated names or patterns such as node_modules, *.log or build/*.map (patterns with / match the path). Symbolic links are skipped.
The result is a tree. By default only differences are shown; folders containing differences are marked as changed. The newer side of a changed file is shown in bold.
Click a changed text file to see a side-by-side diff below. ⌘ / Ctrl-click selects several entries.

Copy → / ← copies the selected files or folders to the other side, replacing files there after you confirm. Modification times are kept, and the folders are compared again afterwards. Nothing is ever deleted.
